name: 贾维斯数字员工公司
author: ljjluke
description: 给 DSH 用的数字员工公司：识别行业→现场 web 蒸馏该领域真实大佬做 CEO/子角色（六段式+协同架构+source+防冒名，jarvis_distill 校验）→AgentTeams 并行建队协作→收口交付。铁律：角色卡每次现场蒸馏，绝不复用旧卡。
descriptionEn: A digital-employee company for DSH: identify the industry, live-distill the domain's real authority into CEO/sub-role cards (six-section + co-architecture + source + anti-impersonation, validated by jarvis_distill), build a parallel AgentTeams team, and deliver. Hard rule: every role card is live-distilled per requirement, never reused.
